questions.question: The UI can't do this, so which code change should I make on a branch?

options.label: Filter the results file (Recommended)
options.description: Exactly what you asked: the rule stays on everywhere except kernel driver.py and _io.py. The analyze step stops uploading, a short inline Python step removes the matching results from the SARIF file (the file of results it uploads) and upload-sarif sends the rest. No new third-party action, about 20 lines of YAML.

options.label: Turn the rule off everywhere
options.description: Three lines in codeql-config.yml (query-filters: exclude: id: py/ineffectual-statement). Simplest, but it also hides real ineffectual statements (e.g. a stray `x == 1`) in every other file.

options.label: Docstrings instead of ...
options.description: No CodeQL change. Each protocol method body becomes a docstring, which CodeQL accepts. It touches about 40 methods in the sync and async kernels; the sync side may be generated from async, so the generator would need checking too.
